title: Extend Database Schema for Conversations and Messages
description: Add new tables to the Drizzle ORM schema to support chat conversations and messages, associating them with users.
details: Update the Drizzle schema file (e.g., `lib/db/schema.ts`) to define `conversations` and `messages` tables. Each conversation should have a unique ID, a user ID foreign key, a title or timestamp, and metadata for model selection. Each message should reference its conversation, include sender (user or AI), content, attachments (for multi-modal), and timestamps. Run Drizzle migrations to apply changes. Ensure referential integrity and appropriate indexing for performance.
test_strategy:
- Write unit tests for schema validation.
- Run migration and verify tables are created.
- Insert and query sample data to ensure relationships work as expected.

title: Implement AI Chat API Route with Streaming and Persistence
description: Create the `/api/chat` API route to handle chat requests, stream AI responses using Vercel's AI SDK, and persist messages to the database.
details:
Create `app/api/chat/route.ts`. Implement a POST handler that:
- Authenticates the user session.
- Accepts input: conversation ID (optional), message content, model selection, and attachments (for multi-modal).
- Uses Vercel's `@ai-sdk` to stream responses from the selected model.
- Streams tokens back to the client in real time.
- On completion, saves both the user message and AI response to the appropriate conversation in the database using Drizzle ORM.
- Handles errors gracefully and returns appropriate status codes.
test_strategy:
- Write integration tests to mock AI SDK and verify streaming and persistence.
- Test with valid and invalid payloads, and with/without authentication.
- Verify messages are saved correctly in the database.

title: Build Chat UI Page with assistant-ui Integration
description: Create the `/dashboard/chat` page as a client component, integrating `assistant-ui` for the chat interface and connecting it to the API route.
details: Create `app/dashboard/chat/page.tsx` as a client component. Use `AssistantRuntimeProvider` and `AssistantView` from `assistant-ui` to render the chat interface. Configure it to call `/api/chat` for message streaming. Implement model selection UI and support for multi-modal inputs (attachments, canvas). Ensure the UI is responsive, accessible, and matches the app's theming (Tailwind, shadcn/ui).
test_strategy:
- Manual and automated UI tests for sending/receiving messages, model selection, and attachments.
- Verify streaming works and UI updates in real time.
- Test on mobile and desktop, and in dark/light mode.

title: Update Dashboard Navigation to Include Chat
description: Add a navigation link to the new Chat page in the dashboard sidebar or layout.
details: Modify `app/dashboard/layout.tsx` or `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` to include a link to `/dashboard/chat`. Ensure the link is visible only to authenticated users and matches the existing navigation style. Optionally, display active conversations or recent chats in the sidebar.
test_strategy:
- Verify the link appears for logged-in users and navigates to the chat page.
- Test navigation on mobile and desktop layouts.

title: Implement End-to-End and Integration Tests for AI Chat Flow
description: Ensure the entire AI Chat feature works as expected by writing comprehensive tests covering backend, frontend, and user flows.
details:
- Write integration tests for the `/api/chat` endpoint, including streaming, authentication, and error handling.
- Write end-to-end (E2E) tests simulating a user logging in, navigating to chat, sending messages, and receiving streamed responses.
- Test multi-modal inputs and model selection.
- Use mocks for external AI SDK calls where appropriate.
test_strategy:
- Run all tests in CI and locally.
- Ensure high coverage for critical paths (message send/receive, streaming, persistence).
- Manually test edge cases and error states.
